newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy DPEF forecasts ready by May 25 - official says.
newsitem.headline: Italy DPEF forecasts ready by May 25 - official says.

text.p: The Italian government will publish its three-year document of key economic forecasts (DPEF) by May 25, Treasury undersecretary Giorgio Macciotta said on Friday.
"We're working on it. There will be a slight slip, but not a significant one -- 10 days at most," Macciotta told Reuters, referring to the May 15 deadline for presentation of the plan.
"We won't go beyond May 25," he said.

Macciotta said the delay was in order to make the document conform with a convergence plan which Italy must present to the European Commission to demonstrate its progress towards achieving and sustaining the three percent deficit-GDP goal required for European single currency hopefuls.
The DPEF is also due to contain an signposts for the reform of Italy's welfare state.
